title: Moroccan Sterbottensost Pastilla
description: A Moroccan-inspired dish using the unique flavor of Sterbottensost cheese, perfect for a delicious dinner.
instructions: Thaw the phyllo dough according to the package instructions.
Cut the Sterbottensost cheese into small pieces.
In a bowl, mix together the paprika, cumin, and salt.
Layer the phyllo dough in a baking dish, brushing each layer with butter.
Sprinkle the cheese mixture and the paprika mixture over the phyllo dough.
Roll the pastilla tightly and place it seam-side down in the baking dish.
Brush the top of the pastilla with butter.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown.
Sprinkle with fresh cilantro before serving.
